title: Excessive privileged access
root_cause: Periodic access review identified inappropriate permissions
remediation_action: Remove unnecessary privileges and validate access against approved roles

title: Incomplete audit evidence
root_cause: Evidence checklist was not completed before submission
remediation_action: Introduce a mandatory evidence quality review before audit submission

title: Critical vulnerability remediation delay
root_cause: Remediation ownership and escalation timelines were unclear
remediation_action: Assign remediation owners and implement overdue vulnerability escalation

title: Backup restoration test exception
root_cause: Restoration testing did not meet the documented recovery requirement
remediation_action: Repeat restoration testing and retain evidence of successful recovery

title: Production change approval evidence gap
root_cause: Approval evidence was not consistently attached to change records
remediation_action: Enforce approval evidence checks before production deployment
